analysis_content.text: moderate association是中等关联，causality could not be established明确未能确立因果，因此A正确。B、C说因果已证明，D用inevitably determines宣布必然决定，都加强了结论。
tips: 找证据是在报告关联，还是明确检验了因果，不能把一个词当另一个。

任务：哪项是绝对化？

back_content.text: 答案：D。Younger workers are always willing to leave any employer, regardless of sector.
back_content.explanation: often与weaker in sectors ...保留频率和行业差异。D的always、any employer、regardless of sector恰好把这些限制全去掉了。A、B、C仍保留趋势与限制。

analysis_content.text: often与weaker in sectors ...保留频率和行业差异。D的always、any employer、regardless of sector恰好把这些限制全去掉了。A、B、C仍保留趋势与限制。
tips: 同一趋势在不同行业可能强弱不同，比较选项时别漏sector限定。

options.text: Younger workers are often more willing to change employers.
The tendency is weaker in sectors with strong apprenticeship traditions.
The article presents a trend with an important qualification.
Younger workers are always willing to leave any employer, regardless of sector.
